d: France is witnessing one of its most violent waves of unrest in years, with more than 2,000 people detained and over 600 security personnel injured. What began as student protests over deteriorating school conditions has widened into a movement fuelled by rising living costs and anger over government inaction. Fires, looting and clashes have left a trail of destruction, including damage to historic buildings. President Emmanuel Macron has vowed to hold those responsible accountable, as the government faces mounting pressure to restore order.
